brief: Homepage for a small scheduling tool. Visitors are freelancers comparing tools; the one job is to get them to start a free trial. The committed direction is calm and plain: one headline, one primary action, proof below the fold.
method: lead + visual + a11y + copy, director pass
direction: The page asks for a trial before it shows what the product does; move one concrete product view above the fold before polishing anything else.

working.title: One primary action per viewport
working.why: The trial button is the only filled control on the first screen, so the next step is never in doubt. Keep secondary links as text.

working.title: Headline length fits the measure
working.why: At 1440 the headline wraps at about 50 characters, which reads in one pass. Don't widen the column.

notes.title: Subheading text fails contrast
notes.what: The subheading is light gray on near-white. The copy deck also renders a raw tag here: <script>alert(1)</script>
notes.effect: Low-vision visitors and anyone outdoors on a phone can't read the line that explains the product.
notes.fix: Set the subheading to #5F5F5F or darker on #EEEEEE (5.6:1).

notes.title: Trial button sits below the fold at 1440
notes.what: The primary action is 840px down on a 900px viewport and shares the line with the fold.
notes.effect: Most visitors decide from the first screen; a half-visible button reads as decoration.
notes.fix: Cut the hero top padding from 200px to 96px so the button lands near 620px.

notes.title: Band section has no heading
notes.what: The gray band carries three claims but no heading, so it is skipped by screen-reader heading navigation.
notes.effect: Keyboard and screen-reader users can't jump to the proof section.
notes.fix: Add an h2 "Why freelancers switch" at the top of the band.

notes.title: Side card competes with the headline
notes.what: The testimonial card is the largest block on the first screen and sits level with the headline.
notes.effect: The eye may land on the quote first and miss what the product is.
notes.fix: Drop the card to 520px wide and align its top with the subheading, not the headline.

notes.title: Card inset is tighter than the page gutter
notes.what: Text in the band starts 16px from its edge while the page uses 24px.
notes.effect: A small misalignment that makes the band feel pasted in.
notes.fix: Use the 24px token for the band's inline padding.

questions.q: Is the testimonial card meant to be the first thing people read?
Should the trial button stay on one line at 390?
